title: 真实glibc内存诊断：free后RSS可保留，trim能归还空闲页，存活增长不等于已证明泄漏

body:
## 操作任务
实现diagnose(rows)。rows是隔离单线程glibc子进程的实际快照，含phase/cycle/live_bytes（夹具分配账本）/rss_bytes/uordblks/fordblks/arena/hblkhd。baseline基线后，cycle0..2各含allocated/freed/trimmed：分配并触页32MiB，再free，最后仅该实验进程malloc_trim。每周期若freed.live_bytes=0、uordblks较allocated减少、fordblks较allocated增加、RSS仍高于基线且trimmed.RSS下降，则计allocator retention。另live-after-trim保留16MiB存活分配：live_bytes/uordblks/RSS均高于基线时标记真实存活增长。返回retention_cycles、allocator_retention_observed（恰3周期）、live_allocation_growth_observed、leak_proven=False、production_trim_recommended=False、scope=private-single-thread-glibc-fixture。不改rows；不能把RSS不降或存活对象增加直接称为泄漏，不能把实验trim建议推广到生产。实际验收包括三轮RSS保留上界、释放后活跃分配归零、空闲页归还及仍存活内存不可被trim释放。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
实际glibc mallinfo2/mallopt/malloc/free/malloc_trim与/proc/self/statm，限定自有短生命周期单线程C子进程，32MiB工作集和16MiB存活对照。只为该子进程固定分配器参数，不attach/暂停外部进程、不改变宿主/应用分配器参数。mallinfo2主arena范围和本夹具分配账本不能代表任意多线程应用全堆。区别Python024的tracemalloc不覆盖native分配，本题考察free后allocator保留/trim与多轮上界；不证明生产泄漏根因或永久修复，不构建镜像。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys
sys.path[:0]=[os.getcwd(),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
import task
assert os.geteuid()==1000 and sys.platform=='linux'
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
compiled=subprocess.run(['gcc','-O0','-Wall','-Wextra','checks/allocator.c','-o','checks/allocator'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
assert compiled.returncode==0,compiled.stderr
run=subprocess.run(['checks/allocator'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
assert run.returncode==0,run.stderr
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in run.stdout.splitlines()];assert len(rows)==12
base=rows[0];freed=[];trimmed=[];MiB=1024*1024
for cycle in range(3):
 phases={row['phase']:row for row in rows if row['cycle']==cycle};peak=phases['allocated'];free=phases['freed'];trim=phases['trimmed']
 assert peak['live_bytes']==32*MiB and free['live_bytes']==trim['live_bytes']==0
 assert peak['hblkhd']==free['hblkhd']==0,'fixture unexpectedly used mmap allocation'
 assert free['rss_bytes']>base['rss_bytes']+24*MiB and free['uordblks']<base['uordblks']+65536
 assert free['fordblks']>24*MiB and trim['rss_bytes']<free['rss_bytes']-24*MiB
 freed.append(free['rss_bytes']);trimmed.append(trim['rss_bytes'])
assert max(freed)-min(freed)<2*MiB and max(trimmed)-min(trimmed)<2*MiB,'repeated workload did not retain a bounded plateau'
held=next(row for row in rows if row['phase']=='live-after-trim')
assert held['live_bytes']==16*MiB and held['uordblks']>base['uordblks']+12*MiB and held['rss_bytes']>base['rss_bytes']+12*MiB
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:actual_glibc_free_chunks_rss_retention_vs_live_allocation_growth',flush=True)
before=copy.deepcopy(rows);report=task.diagnose(rows);assert rows==before
assert report==dict(retention_cycles=3,allocator_retention_observed=True,live_allocation_growth_observed=True,leak_proven=False,
 production_trim_recommended=False,scope='private-single-thread-glibc-fixture'),'RSS retention or live objects incorrectly called a proven leak'
print('NATIVE_THREE_NATIVE_MALLOC_FREE_TRIM_CYCLES_RSS_BOUNDED_WHILE_LIVE_BYTES_ZERO '+json.dumps(dict(baseline=base,freed_rss=freed,trimmed_rss=trimmed)),flush=True)
print('NATIVE_RETAINED_16M_LIVE_ALLOCATIONS_SURVIVE_TRIM_NO_PRODUCTION_ATTACH_OR_GLOBAL_ALLOCATOR_CHANGE',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
